harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «إذا»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقسم (I swear).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «ما ودَّعك ربك» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to a new oath; the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير», and so is «من الأولى»; and the clause «وللآخرة خير» is conjoined to the answer to the preceding oath.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «ولسوف يعطيك ربك» is conjoined to the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the lām is that of the answer to an oath.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «أما»: a particle of condition and detailing; «اليتيم»: an object placed before «تقهر»; the fāʾ is the linking one; and the clause «لا تقهر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وأما السائل فلا تنهر» is conjoined to the clause {فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلا تَقْهَرْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The preposition «بنعمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «حدِّث».
